rules.normative_text: There is exactly one canonical governing-file manifest: policy/corpus/governing-files.json. No parallel governing-file inventory may independently define scope.

The sole canonical governing-file manifest for H1-B1A-G must include every existing H1-B0 root path and every accepted H1-B1A-G path. An unknown or unclassified governing file is blocking when later scanners run; this gate establishes the initial closed inventory only.

The governing-file manifest must not embed mutable branch names, current issue status, current pull-request status, or current main SHA as permanent stable policy. Content hashes of proposed or review-package files are review evidence, not permanent normative classification entries for this manifest itself.

H1-B0 bootstrap evidence files must be classified honestly. Bootstrap manifests and state are HISTORICAL_AUDIT_EVIDENCE. CODEOWNERS, GOVERNANCE_ROOT_CHARTER.md, and SECURITY.md are STABLE_POLICY bootstrap controls. README.md is NON_NORMATIVE_GUIDANCE. H1-B1A-G must not rewrite or reinterpret their repository bytes.

Each manifest entry must contain path, primary_classification, owner, policy_owner, normative_status, schema_reference, version_reference, supersession_policy, source_requirement_ids, and control_of_controls_scope.
Exact H1-B1A-G proposed repository paths are limited to the eleven paths authorized by owner decision H1B1-OD-001. Expansion requires a new owner decision.

policy/corpus/governing-files.json must contain dependency_impact_entries providing a complete dependency and impact inventory for every current governing file, policy document, schema, and rule ID, plus future component classes marked NOT_YET_EXISTS with assigned_gate. Each entry must include artifact_id, artifact_type, path_or_rule_id, depends_on, consumed_by, change_impact, control_of_controls_scope, existence_status, and assigned_gate.

Governing-artifact inventory uses the hybrid model: existing artifacts use exact locators; future components use closed class records with existence_status=NOT_YET_EXISTS, exact_path=UNRESOLVED_BY_CURRENT_GATE, and implementation_authority=NONE. Unapproved future filenames must not be invented. Every existing artifact, current rule, schema, and required future class has exactly one dependency-impact record with resolvable depends_on and consumed_by references.
